about.label: About Botanick
about.title:
Flowers as a
language
about.body1: Every stem, leaf, and petal has something to say. At Botanick, we believe that the most meaningful arrangements are the ones that feel alive — that carry the scent of morning dew and the quiet poetry of the natural world.
about.quote: "I don't just arrange flowers — I compose moments."
about.body2: Based in Belgium, Botanick works with locally sourced and seasonal blooms wherever possible, creating designs that are both beautiful and mindful of our earth. From intimate bouquets to full event installations, every piece is made with intention.

wedding.title: Bridal & Ceremony
wedding.desc: Bespoke bouquets, ceremony arches, table centrepieces, and full floral styling for your most important day.

seasonal.title: Seasonal Arrangements
seasonal.desc: Fresh compositions that celebrate what's blooming right now — honest, local, and alive.

xmas.title: Christmas & Winter
xmas.desc: Wreaths, garlands, centrepieces, and festive installations that bring warmth to the season.

corp.title: Corporate Events
corp.desc: Elegant, brand-aligned floral design for launches, conferences, and office environments.

funeral.title: Tribute & Sympathy
funeral.desc: Thoughtful tributes crafted with care — coffin sprays, standing tributes, and heartfelt posies.

occasions.label: Occasions
occasions.title:
Every moment
deserves flowers
occasions.sub: Each occasion calls for something different. Explore Botanick's specialisms below.

weddings.title: Weddings & Bridal
weddings.p1: Your wedding flowers should feel like an extension of you. Botanick works closely with couples from the initial consultation through to your wedding day.
weddings.p2: We offer full-day bridal styling packages as well as individual pieces for intimate ceremonies.

seasonal.title: Seasonal Arrangements
seasonal.p1: Nature sets the palette. Botanick creates seasonal bouquets using whatever is at its very best right now — tulips in spring, dahlias in late summer, foliage and berries in autumn.
seasonal.p2: Order a recurring seasonal subscription or a one-off arrangement for your home or loved one.

christmas.title: Christmas & Winter
christmas.p1: Winter is the most atmospheric season for floral design. Think dried oranges, pine, eucalyptus, amaryllis, and candlelight.
christmas.p2: Orders open each November — get in touch early to secure your slot.

corporate.title: Corporate Events
corporate.p1: First impressions matter. Botanick provides thoughtful floral design for product launches, office receptions, conferences, and corporate gifting — always on brand, always on time.
corporate.p2: Monthly office subscriptions and one-off event packages are available.

funerals.title: Funerals & Sympathy
funerals.p1: Saying goodbye deserves the same care and beauty as any other moment. Botanick creates sensitive, personal tributes — coffin sprays, standing wreaths, and memory bouquets.
funerals.p2: Please reach out directly for compassionate and prompt assistance.
